verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos or a short skirmish into Mordekaiser before level 6, since his longer Q range and Death's Grasp pull win that fight; you win if you farm Siphoning Strike stacks behind Spirit Fire and only commit once Fury of the Sands' health drain outpaces what his Indestructible shield can heal back.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate, range 675) outranges your Q (Siphoning Strike, range 255), and his E (Death's Grasp, range 700) is a hard pull that chains straight into three landed hits for his passive Darkness Rise aura — so short-range skirmishes favor him on paper and in the measured data (Mordekaiser holds lane and solo-kill advantage). Your actual win condition is refusing those skirmishes entirely: stand at max range, farm with Spirit Fire's zone damage instead of autos, and only commit once your stacked Q damage and Fury of the Sands' drain outscale his shield-heal loop.

theirWindow.what: He'll immediately follow with Q and autos to complete his 3-hit Darkness Rise proc, gaining a damage and move-speed aura mid-combo; disengage or use W (Wither) on him the moment the pull connects rather than trading back.

yourWindow.when: Q stacks are high and R is up
yourWindow.what: Lead with E (Spirit Fire) to strip his armor, then commit with Q and R (Fury of the Sands) active; the sustained max-health drain from R plus Soul Eater lifesteal outpaces what his W (Indestructible) shield can consume and heal back.

start.why: The highest-pick-rate start (60.2% pick, 46.6% WR over 118 games); its block and regen absorb his Q poke and auto chip while you sit back and farm instead of answering trades.

boots.why: Best measured boots here (53.8% WR, 48.4% pick); the ability haste shortens Wither and Spirit Fire cooldowns so you can zone-farm and slow his engages more often per minute.

core.why: The Spellblade proc adds real burst to your short-range Q trades and the move speed lets you disengage before he strings autos into his passive aura.
Magic resist and heal amp directly answers his all-magic Q/E combo and stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal to win extended lane sustain.
The attack-speed slow weakens his auto-reliant passive stacking (he needs 3 landed hits) and the cooldown reduction keeps your Wither and Spirit Fire cycling.

situational.when: he's leaning on Indestructible's shield-to-heal loop and you need grievous wounds to shut it off
you need the early armor spike and grievous wounds before his first all-in window closes
their team stacks magic damage beyond Mordekaiser alone

runes.keystoneWhy: The heal-on-hit kicks in while you're safely farming waves at range instead of trading autos, offsetting the chip damage from his longer-range Q.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best measured win rate in this matchup (59% over tracked games); Flash is your out from his Death's Grasp pull range, and Teleport lets you reset after losing an early skirmish and keep executing the farm-first plan.

playing.title: Stand outside 675 range
playing.detail: His Q (Obliterate, range 675) outranges your Q (255); only step inside his Q range to last-hit, then retreat so you're not eating free pokes.

playing.title: Count his passive hits
playing.detail: Darkness Rise procs after 3 landed attacks or spells on you; if he's already at 2, disengage rather than trade a third hit into his damage-and-speed buff.

playing.title: Farm with Spirit Fire, not autos
playing.detail: Use E (12s cooldown, range 650) on cannon waves and contested minions to clear safely and shred his armor if he steps on it, instead of trading melee autos you lose.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp timing
playing.detail: His E pull is on a 16s cooldown at rank 1, dropping to 8s by rank 5; track whether he's thrown it recently before pushing your wave past the midline.

playing.title: Save Wither for his all-in
playing.detail: W (15/14/13/12/11s cooldown) decelerates his move and attack speed; hold it to punish his E-engage rather than opening with it, since you lose a short burst window against him.

playing.title: Bank Q resets before 6
playing.detail: Every kill with Q permanently raises its damage; prioritize uncontested stacks exactly as OP.GG's own read says — grow stacks while tracking his cooldowns, don't force trades.

playing.title: Ult to flip extended fights
playing.detail: R (120s cooldown) grants bonus health, range, and max-health drain for its duration; trigger it once you have a real Q stack so your sustain outlasts his Indestructible shield-heal.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG across 151 head-to-head games; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read, not measured data.
